dct_description_sm: In order to address the lack of baseline oceanographic data from Dease Strait and Queen Maud Gulf, an exploratory study has been undertaken in July 2013 aboard the R/V Martin Bergmann with the purpose of establishing new monitoring lines and sediment sampling stations in this area. The immediate objectives of this investigation were the examination of the influence of sea ice melt and rivers on the freshwater budget and organic carbon cycle in coastal bays, the examination of the influence of these gradients on primary production and their by-products in the investigation area, the examination of microbial diversity in seawater and marine sediments as it relates to in situ biogeochemical cycling and the potential microbial response to increased industrial activity, as well as the examination of the surface distribution of pCO2 in seawater as a function of the previous objectives.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Microbial community
dct_title_s: Baseline oceanographic data from Dease Strait and western Queen Maud Gulf
